description_en: The small courtyard is paved withteliyātiles and can be accessed from Nāga Bāhāḥ or from the narrow street that runs from Tapā Hitī to Jhatāpol. At the courtyard's centre is a stone Sikharakūṭa Caitya. Thiscaityais surrounded by a balustrade with oil lamps and has a suspended squarechatra. Local inhabitants call this courtyard a Nibhāḥ Cuka (a courtyard with acaitya). The inscription on the plinth of thecaityainforms that it was established in 1717 CE (NS 837). The upper part of thecaitya, starting from thegarbhagṛha,was once covered with a gold-coated copper plate, but that part has been broken and the cover stolen. As a result, the part containingharmikāandtrayodaśabhuvanahas been attached to thegarbhausing cement plaster. There is achatraon the top of thecaitya.The Śākyas of the Lāvo community claim that their ancestors built thisbāhāḥ. According toLocke(1985:66), the courtyard was originally ananī, later transformed into abāhāḥby thesanghamembers in the early 19th century, who intended to erect a shrine for thekvāpādyaḥ. However, the sponsor died before the statue could be installed and the shrine consecrated. The shrine building, located on the south side of the courtyard, used to have a 3-bay collonaded opening that provided access to Nāga Bāhāḥ. When the house was rebuilt the 3-bay opening was filled in with brick and a new way out was opened up on the western side. Two statues of Mahākāla and Gaṇeśa are enshrined in niches in these infilled walls.East of the courtyard is a residential building with a colonnaded structure on the ground floor and latticed awning windows opening inwards on the first and second floors. The most northern bay of this house has been infilled with a plastered brick wall. The building mostly retains its original character but is in need of renovation. The courtyard is surrounded by a narrow plinth.
description_ne: यो विहार नाग बाहा:को उत्तररतिर अवस्थित छ । स्थानीयहरू यसलाई विहार नभनी चिभा: चुक (चैत्य रहेको चोक) भन्छन् । यो विहार कहिले र कसले बनायो भन्ने थाहा छैन । तर विहार वरिपरि बस्ने लावोँ समूहका शाक्यहरू आफ्नो पुर्खाले यो विहार बनाएको दावी गर्छन् । यो विहारमा क्वापाछेँ र संघसदस्य छैन । विहारको बीचमा शिखरकुट चैत्य रहेको छ । नेसं ८३७ मा स्थापना गरिएको यस चैत्यको गर्भदेखि माथिसम्मको भागमा सुनको मोलम्बा लगाइएको तामाको पाताले मोडिएको थियो । तर चैत्य फोडी उक्त पाता चोरी भएपछि प्लाष्टर गरी चैत्य र कुम्भ जोडिएको छ ।पहिले चैत्यको ठीक सामुन्ने दक्षिणतिर विहारमा पस्ने मूलद्वार रहेको थियो । मूलद्वारको दायाँ-बायाँ फलेचा पनि थियो । तर मूलद्वार रहेको घर जीर्णोद्धार गर्दा पहिलेको बाटो बन्द गरी पश्चिमपट्टि नयाँ बाटो खोलिएको थियो ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths), Rebuilt

historical_events.event_description: Consecration of thecaityain the reign of King Jaya Mahīndra Siṃha Deva (Bhāskara Malla) by Dhani Joti.Locke(1985, 66) mistakenly recorded the date of the inscription as NS 930.
